contract.task_clause:
Which one of the following statements does NOT correctly describe transnational companies (TNCs)?
Option A: Many TNCs operate in areas of electronics, chemicals, pharmaceuticals and petroleum.
Option B: Most TNCs produce and sell manufactured goods.
Option C: Most TNCs are headquartered in the United States, Japan, and the European Union.
Option D: TNCs are generally controlled by foreign governments.
